description: This file defines the IOQueue class, which implements a thread-safe queue for scheduling and executing work items asynchronously using the ThreadPool. It is part of the Orleans networking shared infrastructure.

classes.name: IOQueue
classes.description: A sealed class that manages a queue of work items, scheduling their execution on the thread pool with thread safety and synchronization mechanisms.

methods.name: Schedule
methods.description: Enqueues a work item and schedules its execution if not already scheduled.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Processes queued work items, ensuring thread-safe execution and rescheduling if new work arrives during processing.
